name: Eggradients · Fresh Prince

title.zh: Eggradients · 比较具名渐变与色值

description.zh: 看Fresh Prince默认渐变及色号，控件有广告遮挡。 Eggradients 提供具名渐变预设、Mesh 渐变、纯色 Shades 与调色板，以及 Gradient Maker 等颜色工具。渐变详情页给出角度与 HEX，可复制 CSS、Tailwind、HEX 代码或下载图片；许可与商用条款未见说明。
description.en: Eggradients offers named gradient presets, mesh gradients, solid shades, palettes, and color tools including Gradient Maker. Detail pages show angle and HEX values with copyable CSS, Tailwind and HEX code or image download; license and commercial terms are not stated.

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Eggradients (https://www.eggradients.com/).
Technology stack: tailwind, css, svg.
Component specification: 看Fresh Prince默认渐变及色号，控件有广告遮挡。

Visual details from source observation: 我们先在首页看具名渐变预览，再到蓝色分类比较多组配色；目录只是这个分类的可见子集，不代表全库已清点。Fresh Prince详情能看到绿色渐变、两组HEX和线性角度标记，下方控件仍有广告遮挡，本次没有复制、改参数或下载。适合先找背景配色方向，预设费用、许可和商用范围仍未核实，正式使用前需另行确认。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
